headline: Stealth's Space-Bunny Explodes Into #2, Reshuffles the Board
summary: stealth/space-bunny-alpha rocketed 15 spots overnight to claim 12.1% share and the #2 slot, marking an all-time high. DeepSeek still leads at 12.6% but lost ground; the top three (DeepSeek, Zhipu AI, stealth) now command 46.5% combined. Three new models entered the rankings while three dropped out.
highlights: stealth/space-bunny-alpha: rank 2, 12.1% share — +10.7% in one day, all-time record
DeepSeek holds #1 at 12.6% but down 1.5% day-over-day; provider share 21.6% (−2.7% 1d)
Top 4 providers (DeepSeek, Zhipu AI, stealth, OpenAI) hold 57.9% of tokens
